Lead Ennis Granitestrider into the furnace so he can complete his [[The Forge Heart|task]] there.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Locate [[Ennis Granitestrider]].
* Help Ennis Granitestrider complete his [[The Forge Heart|mission]] inside Sorrow's Furnace.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]

== Walkthrough ==
This should be a walk in the park by now, since you had to travel to [[Sorrow's Furnace]] several times already for the preceding quest [[To Sorrow's Furnace]]. Talk to [[Ennis Granitestrider]], who will be waiting patiently on the right when you exit [[Deldrimor War Camp]] in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]. Kill some patrols and just walk into the exit to Sorrow's Furnace.

Here you will receive the quest [[The Forge Heart]]. To get past the gates, use the explosives given by [[Budger Blackpowder]].

After completing the quest, walk back to Ennis Granitestrider just inside the entrance gate if necessary to accept the reward.  Do not leave the instance until after accepting the reward for The Forge Heart, since if you exit prematurely then The Forge Heart quest is removed from your quest log and you will have to repeat it.

Once The Forge Heart is complete, you can leave and turn in The Final Assault with the [[Dwarven Prospector]].

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Dwarven Prospector
''Ennis Granitestrider is looking for ye. He's planning some sort of move against the Stone Summit and he needs yer help. What do ye suppose they're doin' down there in the Furnace? If ye'll come back and tell me what ye find, I'll pay ye what I can.... Anyway, ye'd best find [[Ennis Granitestrider]] straightaway.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'm on my way.
| decline = I've got other things to do.
| ask = Have ye found Ennis yet? I know he's anxious to speak w'ye...
}}

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
:'''Ernis Granitestrider''': ''Thanks largely to yer efforts, I've learned that the Stone Summit are building a golem for an assailt on Deldrimor. Together, I think we can destroy it and cancel the little party they have planned. Let's go.''

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Dwarven Prospector
''A golem? Ye don't say? Well, I'm glad to hear ye dealt with that menace. Here's fer yer trouble.''

== Notes ==
* This quest sets up the spawns for [[The Forge Heart]], including the [[Iron Forgeman]], whose attack is required to hatch a [[Black Moa Chick]] once the player has acquired and filled an [[Incubator Kit]].
* Completion of this quest unlocks the [[Eternal Conqueror of Sorrow's Furnace]] statue in the [[Hall of Monuments]]. 

{{bug|Sometimes Ennis stops following you on the path to Sorrow's Furnace. Once inside, he will not appear and you have to come back to the starting point. To prevent this, click and talk to Ennis just before entering to ensure he is following.}}
